review.scope: Existing B3 fact targets retain their separately reviewed pinned sources. Tool choices follow the four read-only diagnostics. Chat, refusals and result explanations are teacher-authored synthetic targets. Success fixtures use only current public projection fields; failures use the fixed unavailable message. All numbers, hashes and states are simulated, not live observations. Hashes establish source identity, not truth. Distinct validation wording and values test familiar formats and facts, not independent knowledge or real tool competence.
